text: ひきわけ　じゃったか！

structure.jp: ひきわけ　じゃったか！

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃった is the old-man form of だった, 'was'. ひきわけ　じゃった = 'it was a draw'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realization)
patterns.explanation: か at the end here is not a real question. It shows the speaker taking in what just happened, like 'so it was...'. じゃったか = 'so that's how it was'.
